name: tccc-evaluation-suite
description: Offline Android TCCC Tier 1-4 evaluation suite for class-based scenario grading.

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-content.mjs && node --check www/app.js && node --check www/tiers.js
scripts.android:prepare: node scripts/prepare-android.mjs && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && bash scripts/apply-android-native-branding.sh && node scripts/harden-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npx cap sync android && bash scripts/apply-android-native-branding.sh && node scripts/harden-android.mjs
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
